2 x Virginia Payload Tubes (6-cell each, Block III+), 12 Tomahawk vertical payload

weapon_inventory[Mk48].representative_lo.note: torpedo-room capacity ~25 torpedo-sized weapons total (sourced, A) split against 12 Tomahawk in VPTs; 20 assumed as a representative peacetime ASW-heavy load, not a fixed figure

modeling_notes: Health scaled as one HP per metric tonne of submerged displacement, consistent with ship-record convention (repo's Kilo-class MVP uses the same scaling).

No naval_weapon_system.mounts[] block: none of Virginia's weapons (Mk48 torpedo, Tomahawk TLAM/MST, VLA-family successors) map onto the engine's 3 functional NavalWeaponType values (vls_sam, gun_5in, ciws) since none are a VLS-launched SAM, deck gun, or CIWS mount. All weapons are therefore content_only_no_mechanism in _real_world.weapon_inventory, consistent with how these same weapon records are treated on the DDG records for any non-VLS/gun/CIWS weapon.

damage_model.hitboxes[] is a deviation from the repo's existing Kilo_Class_MVP example (which has no damage_model.hitboxes at all), added here because the task explicitly requires 'each ship/sub needs explicit damage_model.hitboxes with components[] naming real systems.' 4 zones chosen (bow/torpedo room, command/VPT, reactor/propulsion, stern/towed-array winch) to give distinct real-system groupings consistent with the DDG records' pattern; component naming follows the corrected name/system-only DamageComponent schema (no hp field), matching the fix already applied to ddg51_flight_iia.json and ddg51_flight_ii.json.

Virginia Payload Tubes modeled only as named damage components (virginia_payload_tube_1/2), not as naval_weapon_system mounts, since VPT-launched Tomahawk has no engine mount mechanism (content_only_no_mechanism, same as the DDGs' Tomahawk handling).
